changes.observation: The orange hub is lower and slightly left; tooth profiles were redrawn and its lower-left rim lies closer to the blue rim.
Same readable three-line Hangul, palette, hub shapes, large-wheel crop and shared wedge were retained.
Slightly unequal sector widths add a weak opposite-sense cue; small-wheel angular extent remains greater.
Fine curled fibers became more prominent across wide surfaces than in initial.

residuals.limit: The connection is closer but still shallow; clear engagement of alternating teeth into matching valleys remains uncertain.
More conspicuous curled texture repeats across background and wheels.
Opposite rotation is only weakly suggested by sector width changes, especially at reduced size.
